title: Cube root of a rational number
competency: Calculate the cube root of perfect cubes.

keywords.def: One of the three identical factors whose product is the number: ∛27 = 3 because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.
The symbol √ (or ∛ for a cube root).
The small number on a radical sign: in ∛a the index is 3. No index means a square root.
The number under the radical sign: in √b, b is the radicand.

en.text: A cube root undoes cubing. ∛27 = 3 because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27. To find one, share the prime factors into three equal groups. Every rational number has exactly one cube root, and the cube root of a negative number is negative: ∛(−343) = −7. In exponent form ∛a = a^(1/3).

am.text: ኪዩብ ሥር ማኪዩብን ይቀለብሳል። ∛27 = 3 ምክንያቱም 3 × 3 × 3 = 27። ፍጹም ቁጥሮቹን በሦስት እኩል ቡድን አካፍል።

screens.title: From volume to edge
screens.ask: A cube-shaped water tank holds 8 cubic metres. How long is each edge?
screens.after: 2 m, because 2 × 2 × 2 = 8. Finding the edge from the volume is taking the cube root.

screens.title: 64 small cubes
screens.intro: 64 small cubes make one big cube. How many along each edge?
say: Four layers: 16 × 4 = 64. The edge is 4, so ∛64 = 4.

screens.title: Cube roots
paras: Definition 2.6: The cube root of a number is one of the three identical factors whose product is the number.
2 × 2 × 2 = 8, so 2 is the cube root of 8.
3³ = 27, so 3 = ∛27. Read it "the cube root of 27".

screens.title: The parts of a radical
paras: In ∛a, the symbol ∛ is the radical sign.
3 is the index and a is the radicand.
When no index is written, the radical sign means a square root.
screens.note: ∛a = a^(1/3). Each rational number has exactly one cube root.

screens.title: ∛1728: share the primes into three equal groups
Now ∛(−1728)
steps: For a negative number, use a negative factor: (−12) × (−12) × (−12).

screens.why:
Ask: which number used three times gives 343?
7 × 7 = 49, and 49 × 7 = 343.
So ∛343 = 7. (49 is 7², and 114 is about 343 ÷ 3.)
screens.clue: Which number used three times gives 343?

screens.title: Grow the tree for 216, then type ∛216.
screens.clue: Look at the three equal groups. Multiply the numbers in one group.

screens.ask: Cube root of a negative number: ∛(−343) = ___
screens.why:
The cube root of a negative number is negative.
(−7) × (−7) = 49, and 49 × (−7) = −343.
So ∛(−343) = −7.
screens.clue: The cube root of a negative number is negative.

screens.text: Exponent form: another name for 4^(1/3) is
screens.why:
The power 1/3 means a cube root: a^(1/3) = ∛a.
So 4^(1/3) = ∛4.
√4 would be 4^(1/2).
screens.clue: The power 1/3 means a cube root.

screens.why:
In ∛a, the small 3 is the index.
The number under the sign (10) is the radicand.
screens.clue: The index is the small number on the radical sign.
Take the cube root of the top and of the bottom.

screens.ask: Undo the cube root: ∛x = −0.3. Then x = ___
screens.clue: Cube both sides. Keep the sign.

items.why:
8 = 2³, 64 = 4³, 216 = 6³.
3 and 9 lie between 1³ and 3³; 400 lies between 7³ = 343 and 8³ = 512.

items.clue: What times itself three times is 0?
